## Under CLR, compare 4 methods

```{r}
# Improved simulation framework for differential topic enrichment
#
# Main changes versus the original draft script:
# 1. Generate true topic proportions with a logistic-normal / softmax model.
# 2. Sample sequencing depth independently of condition and topic proportion.
# 3. Generate counts from a negative-binomial model.
# 4. Use fastTopics::poisson2multinom(...)$L directly as estimated topic proportions.
# 5. Evaluate both oracle (true theta) and recovered (estimated theta) analyses.
# 6. Compare CLR-topic testing variants: no moderation, limma eBayes, vashr,
#    and mr.ashr.
# 7. Provide diagnostics for true/fitted topics, topic memberships by condition,
#    and matched topic recovery.
#
# Note:
# The topic model fit below still uses Poisson NMF (fastTopics) on NB-generated
# counts. That is deliberate if you want to assess robustness to model mismatch.

library(MCMCpack)
library(fastTopics)
library(limma)
library(clue)

softmax_rows <- function(eta) {
  eta <- as.matrix(eta)
  eta <- sweep(eta, 1, apply(eta, 1, max), FUN = "-")
  out <- exp(eta)
  out / rowSums(out)
}

normalize_eps <- function(eps, K) {
  if (length(eps) == 1L) {
    eps <- rep(as.numeric(eps), K)
  } else if (length(eps) != K) {
    stop("eps must have length 1 or match the number of topics.", call. = FALSE)
  } else {
    eps <- as.numeric(eps)
  }

  if (any(!is.finite(eps)) || any(eps <= 0)) {
    stop("eps values must be positive and finite.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  eps
}

topic_specific_eps <- function(theta, c0 = 1e-4, lower = 1e-12, upper = 1e-2) {
  theta <- as.matrix(theta)
  eps <- c0 * apply(theta, 2, stats::median, na.rm = TRUE)
  pmin(pmax(eps, lower), upper)
}

safe_log_theta <- function(theta, eps = 1e-4) {
  theta <- as.matrix(theta)
  eps <- normalize_eps(eps, ncol(theta))
  theta01 <- pmin(pmax(theta, 0), 1)
  log(sweep(theta01, 2, eps, FUN = "+"))
}

logit_transform <- function(theta, eps = 1e-4) {
  theta <- as.matrix(theta)
  eps <- normalize_eps(eps, ncol(theta))
  theta01 <- pmin(pmax(theta, 0), 1)
  num <- sweep(theta01, 2, eps, FUN = "+")
  den <- sweep(1 - theta01, 2, eps, FUN = "+")
  log(num / den)
}

clr_transform <- function(theta, eps = 1e-4) {
  z <- safe_log_theta(theta, eps = eps)
  sweep(z, 1, rowMeans(z), FUN = "-")
}

# This creates the true topic-by-gene matrix 𝜙
make_topic_gene_matrix <- function(K, G,
                                   markers_per_topic = 40,
                                   baseline_shape = 0.2,
                                   marker_boost = 25,
                                   allow_overlap = FALSE) {
  if (!allow_overlap && K * markers_per_topic > G) {
    stop("Need G >= K * markers_per_topic when allow_overlap = FALSE.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  phi <- matrix(0, nrow = K, ncol = G)
  marker_list <- vector("list", K)
  used <- integer(0)
  baseline <- rgamma(G, shape = baseline_shape, rate = 1)

  for (k in seq_len(K)) {
    pool <- if (allow_overlap) seq_len(G) else setdiff(seq_len(G), used)
    marker_idx <- sample(pool, markers_per_topic, replace = FALSE)
    marker_list[[k]] <- marker_idx
    used <- c(used, marker_idx)

    alpha <- baseline
    alpha[marker_idx] <- alpha[marker_idx] * marker_boost
    phi[k, ] <- as.numeric(MCMCpack::rdirichlet(1, alpha + 1e-8))
  }

  colnames(phi) <- paste0("g", seq_len(G))
  list(phi = phi, markers = marker_list)
}

## This creates the true condition-effect matrix 
make_sparse_effects <- function(K, P = 1,
                                n_nonzero_per_condition = 2,
                                effect_size = 1.0,
                                balanced = TRUE) {
  B <- matrix(0, nrow = P, ncol = K)
  rownames(B) <- paste0("x", seq_len(P))

  for (p in seq_len(P)) {
    idx <- sample(seq_len(K), n_nonzero_per_condition, replace = FALSE)
    vals <- rep(effect_size, n_nonzero_per_condition)

    if (balanced && n_nonzero_per_condition >= 2) {
      half <- floor(n_nonzero_per_condition / 2)
      vals[seq_len(half)] <- effect_size
      vals[(half + 1):n_nonzero_per_condition] <- -effect_size
      vals <- sample(vals)
    } else {
      vals <- sample(c(-1, 1), n_nonzero_per_condition, replace = TRUE) * effect_size
    }

    B[p, idx] <- vals
  }

  B
}

# It simulates true topic proportions using a logistic-normal / softmax model.
simulate_topic_proportions <- function(X, B,
                                       alpha_k = NULL,
                                       sigma_eta = 0.6) {
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  N <- nrow(X)
  K <- ncol(B)

  if (ncol(X) != nrow(B)) {
    stop("ncol(X) must equal nrow(B).", call. = FALSE)
  }

  if (is.null(alpha_k)) {
    alpha_k <- rnorm(K, mean = 0, sd = 0.5)
  }

  eta_mean <- matrix(alpha_k, nrow = N, ncol = K, byrow = TRUE) + X %*% B
  eta <- eta_mean + matrix(rnorm(N * K, sd = sigma_eta), nrow = N, ncol = K)
  theta <- softmax_rows(eta)

  list(theta = theta, eta = eta, eta_mean = eta_mean, alpha_k = alpha_k)
}
# This generates gene counts from the true topic proportions.
simulate_nb_counts <- function(theta, phi, depth, size_g = 20) {
  theta <- as.matrix(theta)
  phi <- as.matrix(phi)
  depth <- as.numeric(depth)

  mu <- theta %*% phi
  mu <- sweep(mu, 1, depth, FUN = "*")
  mu <- pmax(mu, 1e-12)

  G <- ncol(mu)
  if (length(size_g) == 1L) {
    size_g <- rep(size_g, G)
  }
  if (length(size_g) != G) {
    stop("size_g must have length 1 or G.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  Y <- matrix(
    rnbinom(
      length(mu),
      mu = as.vector(mu),
      size = rep(size_g, each = nrow(mu))
    ),
    nrow = nrow(mu),
    ncol = ncol(mu)
  )
  colnames(Y) <- colnames(phi)
  Y
}

# Topic models do not preserve topic labels. Estimated topic 1 may really correspond to true topic 4.
# So this function aligns fitted topics to the true topics.
align_topics <- function(phi_true, theta_hat, phi_hat, eps = 1e-8) {
  normalize_rows <- function(M) {
    M / sqrt(rowSums(M^2))
  }

  log_true <- log(phi_true + eps)
  log_hat <- log(phi_hat + eps)
  S <- normalize_rows(log_true) %*% t(normalize_rows(log_hat))
  perm <- as.vector(clue::solve_LSAP(S, maximum = TRUE))

  list(
    perm = perm,
    theta = theta_hat[, perm, drop = FALSE],
    phi = phi_hat[perm, , drop = FALSE],
    matched_similarity = S[cbind(seq_len(nrow(S)), perm)]
  )
}

make_pairwise_logratios <- function(theta, eps = 1e-4) {
  theta <- as.matrix(theta)
  K <- ncol(theta)
  eps <- normalize_eps(eps, K)
  pairs <- t(utils::combn(seq_len(K), 2))
  out <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(theta), ncol = nrow(pairs))

  for (m in seq_len(nrow(pairs))) {
    k <- pairs[m, 1]
    l <- pairs[m, 2]
    log_pair <- safe_log_theta(theta[, c(k, l), drop = FALSE], eps = eps[c(k, l)])
    out[, m] <- log_pair[, 1] - log_pair[, 2]
  }

  colnames(out) <- apply(pairs, 1, function(z) paste0("T", z[1], "_vs_T", z[2]))
  list(mat = out, pairs = pairs)
}

run_limma <- function(feature_matrix, design, coef_index = 2) {
  fit <- limma::lmFit(t(feature_matrix), design)
  fit <- limma::eBayes(fit)
  limma::topTable(fit, coef = coef_index, number = Inf, sort.by = "none")
}

resolve_fit_topics <- function(fit) {
  topics <- rownames(fit$coefficients)
  if (is.null(topics)) {
    topics <- paste0("T", seq_len(nrow(fit$coefficients)))
  }
  topics
}
## This gets results from plain linear regression without empirical Bayes moderation.
extract_nomod_results <- function(fit, coef_index = 2, alpha = 0.05) {
  topics <- resolve_fit_topics(fit)
  betahat <- fit$coefficients[, coef_index]
  se <- fit$stdev.unscaled[, coef_index] * fit$sigma
  df_res <- fit$df.residual
  if (length(df_res) == 1L) {
    df_res <- rep(as.numeric(df_res), length(betahat))
  } else {
    df_res <- as.numeric(df_res)
  }

  ok <- is.finite(betahat) & is.finite(se) & (se > 0) & is.finite(df_res)
  t_stat <- rep(NA_real_, length(betahat))
  pval <- rep(NA_real_, length(betahat))
  t_stat[ok] <- betahat[ok] / se[ok]
  pval[ok] <- 2 * stats::pt(-abs(t_stat[ok]), df = df_res[ok])
  qval <- stats::p.adjust(pval, method = "BH")

  data.frame(
    topic = topics,
    method = "no_eb",
    effect = betahat,
    SE = se,
    df = df_res,
    p_value = pval,
    q_value = qval,
    lfsr = NA_real_,
    detected = qval < alpha,
    available = TRUE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
## extract_limma_results
extract_limma_results <- function(fit, coef_index = 2, alpha = 0.05) {
  tt <- limma::topTable(fit, coef = coef_index, number = Inf, sort.by = "none")
  n_topics <- nrow(tt)
  df_col <- if ("df.total" %in% names(tt)) tt$df.total else rep(NA_real_, n_topics)
  qval <- tt$adj.P.Val
  data.frame(
    topic = rownames(tt),
    method = "limma",
    effect = tt$logFC,
    SE = NA_real_,
    df = df_col,
    p_value = tt$P.Value,
    q_value = qval,
    lfsr = NA_real_,
    detected = qval < alpha,
    available = TRUE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# extract_vash_results
extract_vash_results <- function(fit, coef_index = 2, alpha = 0.05) {
  topics <- resolve_fit_topics(fit)
  if (!requireNamespace("vashr", quietly = TRUE)) {
    return(data.frame(
      topic = topics,
      method = "vashr",
      effect = NA_real_,
      SE = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      q_value = NA_real_,
      lfsr = NA_real_,
      detected = NA,
      available = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }

  sigma_hat <- fit$sigma
  df_res <- as.numeric(fit$df.residual)
  df_scalar <- unique(df_res[is.finite(df_res)])
  df_scalar <- if (length(df_scalar) == 1L) df_scalar else stats::median(df_scalar)

  vfit <- vashr::vash(sehat = sigma_hat, df = df_scalar)

  betahat <- fit$coefficients[, coef_index]
  unscaled <- fit$stdev.unscaled[, coef_index]
  se_raw <- unscaled * sigma_hat
  sigma_post <- vfit$sd.post
  se_mix <- sweep(sqrt(vfit$PosteriorRate / vfit$PosteriorShape), 1, unscaled, "*")
  pval <- vashr::mod_t_test(
    betahat = betahat,
    se = se_mix,
    pi = vfit$PosteriorPi,
    df = 2 * vfit$PosteriorShape
  )
  qval <- stats::p.adjust(pval, method = "BH")

  data.frame(
    topic = topics,
    method = "vashr",
    effect = betahat,
    SE = se_raw,
    df = rep(df_scalar, length(betahat)),
    p_value = pval,
    q_value = qval,
    lfsr = NA_real_,
    detected = qval < alpha,
    available = TRUE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
## Instead of topic-by-topic regression, this does a joint multivariate regression: 
## q-values from adjusted lfsr
residualize_against <- function(y, covariates) {
  if (is.null(covariates) || !ncol(as.matrix(covariates))) {
    return(y)
  }
  Q <- qr(cbind(1, as.matrix(covariates)))
  qr.resid(Q, y)
}

extract_mr_ash_results <- function(feature_matrix,
                                   design,
                                   coef_index = 2,
                                   alpha = 0.05,
                                   standardize = TRUE,
                                   control = list(max.iter = 200)) {
  topics <- colnames(feature_matrix)
  if (is.null(topics)) {
    topics <- paste0("T", seq_len(ncol(feature_matrix)))
  }

  if (!requireNamespace("mr.ashr", quietly = TRUE)) {
    return(data.frame(
      topic = topics,
      method = "mr.ashr",
      effect = NA_real_,
      SE = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      q_value = NA_real_,
      lfsr = NA_real_,
      detected = NA,
      available = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }

  y_use <- as.numeric(design[, coef_index])
  nuisance_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(ncol(design)), c(1L, coef_index))
  X_use <- as.matrix(feature_matrix)
  intercept <- TRUE

  if (length(nuisance_idx)) {
    nuisance <- design[, nuisance_idx, drop = FALSE]
    y_use <- residualize_against(y_use, nuisance)
    X_use <- residualize_against(X_use, nuisance)
    intercept <- FALSE
  }

  # Mr.ASH is a joint multiple-regression model, so here the condition is
  # treated as the response and CLR topics are the predictors.
  fit_mr_ash <- mr.ashr::fit_mr_ash(
    X = X_use,
    y = y_use,
    standardize = standardize,
    intercept = intercept,
    control = control,
    verbose = "none"
  )

  lfsr <- as.numeric(fit_mr_ash$lfsr)
  qval <- stats::p.adjust(lfsr, method = "BH")

  data.frame(
    topic = topics,
    method = "mr.ashr",
    effect = as.numeric(fit_mr_ash$b),
    SE = NA_real_,
    df = NA_real_,
    p_value = NA_real_,
    q_value = qval,
    lfsr = lfsr,
    detected = lfsr < alpha,
    available = TRUE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

score_calls <- function(detected, truth) {
  if (all(is.na(detected))) {
    return(c(TP = NA_real_, FP = NA_real_, power = NA_real_, FDP = NA_real_))
  }

  detected <- as.logical(detected)
  detected[is.na(detected)] <- FALSE
  truth <- as.logical(truth)

  TP <- sum(detected & truth)
  FP <- sum(detected & !truth)
  c(
    TP = TP,
    FP = FP,
    power = if (sum(truth) == 0) NA_real_ else TP / sum(truth),
    FDP = if (sum(detected) == 0) 0 else FP / sum(detected)
  )
}
## Averages TP, FP, power, FDP over simulations, and renames FDP to FDR in the summary table.
summarize_method_metrics <- function(metrics_df) {
  out <- aggregate(cbind(TP, FP, power, FDP) ~ method, data = metrics_df, FUN = mean)
  names(out)[names(out) == "FDP"] <- "FDR"
  out
}

true_pairwise_summaries <- function(beta_k) {
  D <- outer(beta_k, beta_k, FUN = "-")
  absD <- abs(D)
  diag(absD) <- NA_real_
  list(
    D = D,
    Smin = apply(absD, 1, min, na.rm = TRUE),
    Smed = apply(absD, 1, stats::median, na.rm = TRUE),
    Smax = apply(absD, 1, max, na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_nonzero = apply(absD > 1e-12, 1, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

pairwise_topic_summaries <- function(theta, design,
                                     coef_index = 2,
                                     eps = 1e-4,
                                     alpha = 0.05) {
  pw <- make_pairwise_logratios(theta, eps = eps)
  tt <- run_limma(pw$mat, design = design, coef_index = coef_index)
  q <- p.adjust(tt$P.Value, method = "BH")

  K <- ncol(theta)
  Bhat <- matrix(0, nrow = K, ncol = K)
  Qmat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = K, ncol = K)

  for (m in seq_len(nrow(pw$pairs))) {
    k <- pw$pairs[m, 1]
    l <- pw$pairs[m, 2]
    Bhat[k, l] <- tt$logFC[m]
    Bhat[l, k] <- -tt$logFC[m]
    Qmat[k, l] <- q[m]
    Qmat[l, k] <- q[m]
  }

  absB <- abs(Bhat)
  diag(absB) <- NA_real_

  list(
    beta = Bhat,
    q = Qmat,
    Smin = apply(absB, 1, min, na.rm = TRUE),
    Smed = apply(absB, 1, stats::median, na.rm = TRUE),
    Smax = apply(absB, 1, max, na.rm = TRUE),
    fracSig = apply(Qmat < alpha, 1, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

build_condition_labels <- function(X) {
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  if (ncol(X) == 1L) {
    labels <- paste0(colnames(X), "=", X[, 1])
  } else {
    labels <- apply(
      X,
      1,
      function(z) paste0(colnames(X), "=", z, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  factor(labels, levels = unique(labels))
}

prepare_theta_long <- function(theta, X) {
  theta <- as.matrix(theta)
  data.frame(
    sample = rep(seq_len(nrow(theta)), times = ncol(theta)),
    condition = rep(build_condition_labels(X), times = ncol(theta)),
    topic = factor(rep(colnames(theta), each = nrow(theta)), levels = colnames(theta)),
    value = as.vector(theta),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

select_topic_panel_genes <- function(phi, top_n = 12) {
  phi <- as.matrix(phi)
  top_n <- min(top_n, ncol(phi))
  idx <- integer(0)
  for (k in seq_len(nrow(phi))) {
    idx <- c(idx, order(phi[k, ], decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(top_n)])
  }
  unique(idx)
}

prepare_topic_gene_long <- function(phi, gene_idx = NULL) {
  phi <- as.matrix(phi)
  if (is.null(gene_idx)) {
    gene_idx <- select_topic_panel_genes(phi)
  }
  gene_idx <- unique(gene_idx)
  genes <- colnames(phi)[gene_idx]
  if (is.null(genes)) {
    genes <- paste0("g", gene_idx)
  }

  data.frame(
    topic = factor(rep(rownames(phi), each = length(gene_idx)), levels = rev(rownames(phi))),
    gene = factor(rep(genes, times = nrow(phi)), levels = genes),
    weight = as.vector(t(phi[, gene_idx, drop = FALSE])),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
## heatmap of topic-gene weights
plot_topic_gene_heatmap <- function(phi, title_text, top_n = 12) {
  if (!requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("The 'ggplot2' package is required for plotting.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  df <- prepare_topic_gene_long(phi, gene_idx = select_topic_panel_genes(phi, top_n = top_n))

  ggplot2::ggplot(df, ggplot2::aes(x = gene, y = topic, fill = weight)) +
    ggplot2::geom_tile() +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#2166ac") +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank()
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x = "Top topic genes",
      y = "Topic",
      fill = "Weight",
      title = title_text
    )
}
## boxplots of topic membership by condition
plot_topic_membership <- function(theta, X, title_text) {
  if (!requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("The 'ggplot2' package is required for plotting.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  df <- prepare_theta_long(theta, X)

  ggplot2::ggplot(df, ggplot2::aes(x = condition, y = value, fill = condition)) +
    ggplot2::geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, outlier.alpha = 0.35) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ topic, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x = "Condition",
      y = "Topic membership",
      title = title_text
    )
}
## similarity of matched topics
plot_alignment_similarity <- function(matched_similarity) {
  if (!requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("The 'ggplot2' package is required for plotting.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  df <- data.frame(
    topic = factor(paste0("T", seq_along(matched_similarity)), levels = paste0("T", seq_along(matched_similarity))),
    similarity = as.numeric(matched_similarity),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  ggplot2::ggplot(df, ggplot2::aes(x = topic, y = similarity)) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(fill = "#1b9e77") +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x = "Matched topic",
      y = "Cosine similarity",
      title = "True-vs-fitted topic alignment"
    )
}
## power/FDR across simulations
plot_clr_method_performance <- function(per_simulation_df) {
  if (!requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("The 'ggplot2' package is required for plotting.", call. = FALSE)
  }
# 
#   method_levels <- c("no_eb", "limma", "vashr", "mr.ashr")
  method_levels <- c("no_eb", "limma", "vashr", "epb_np", "mr.ashr")
  df_long <- rbind(
    data.frame(
      sim = per_simulation_df$sim,
      method = per_simulation_df$method,
      metric = "Power",
      value = per_simulation_df$power,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ),
    data.frame(
      sim = per_simulation_df$sim,
      method = per_simulation_df$method,
      metric = "FDR",
      value = per_simulation_df$FDP,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  )
  df_long$method <- factor(df_long$method, levels = method_levels)

  summary_long <- aggregate(value ~ method + metric, data = df_long, FUN = mean)

  ggplot2::ggplot(df_long, ggplot2::aes(x = method, y = value, color = method)) +
    ggplot2::geom_jitter(width = 0.12, alpha = 0.5, size = 1.4) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      data = summary_long,
      mapping = ggplot2::aes(x = method, y = value),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      color = "black",
      size = 2.8
    ) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y") +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none") +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x = "Method",
      y = "Across-simulation estimate",
      title = "CLR method performance across simulations"
    )
}

build_diagnostic_plots <- function(simulation, study = NULL, top_n_genes = 12) {
  plots <- list(
    ground_truth_topics = plot_topic_gene_heatmap(
      simulation$phi_true,
      title_text = "Ground-truth topic-gene weights",
      top_n = top_n_genes
    ),
    fitted_topics = plot_topic_gene_heatmap(
      simulation$phi_hat,
      title_text = "Fitted topic-gene weights (aligned to truth)",
      top_n = top_n_genes
    ),
    true_membership = plot_topic_membership(
      simulation$theta_true,
      simulation$X,
      title_text = "Ground-truth topic memberships by condition"
    ),
    fitted_membership = plot_topic_membership(
      simulation$theta_hat,
      simulation$X,
      title_text = "Recovered topic memberships by condition"
    ),
    alignment = plot_alignment_similarity(simulation$matched_similarity)
  )

  if (!is.null(study)) {
    plots$clr_method_performance <- plot_clr_method_performance(study$per_simulation)
  }

  plots
}

save_simulation_outputs <- function(simulation,
                                    study = NULL,
                                    output_dir = file.path("simulations", "results", "improved_topic_simulation"),
                                    top_n_genes = 12,
                                    width = 10,
                                    height = 7,
                                    dpi = 150) {
  if (!requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("The 'ggplot2' package is required for plotting.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  write.csv(
    simulation$clr_truth,
    file.path(output_dir, "single_simulation_clr_truth.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  write.csv(
    simulation$clr_results_long,
    file.path(output_dir, "single_simulation_clr_method_results.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  write.csv(
    data.frame(topic = names(simulation$matched_similarity), similarity = simulation$matched_similarity),
    file.path(output_dir, "single_simulation_topic_alignment.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  if (!is.null(study)) {
    write.csv(
      study$per_simulation,
      file.path(output_dir, "clr_method_metrics_per_simulation.csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )
    write.csv(
      study$summary,
      file.path(output_dir, "clr_method_metrics_summary.csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )
  }

  plots <- build_diagnostic_plots(simulation, study = study, top_n_genes = top_n_genes)
  for (nm in names(plots)) {
    ggplot2::ggsave(
      filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0(nm, ".png")),
      plot = plots[[nm]],
      width = width,
      height = height,
      dpi = dpi
    )
  }

  saveRDS(
    list(simulation = simulation, study = study),
    file = file.path(output_dir, "improved_topic_simulation_results.rds")
  )

  invisible(output_dir)
}
### P: Number of covariates / conditions in the design matrix 
### B: rue effect matrix for covariates on topics, of dimension P×K.
### n_nonzero_per_condition: Used only when B = NULL.
### effect_size: Magnitude of the nonzero entries in B when B = NULL.
### balanced:Used only when B = NULL
## di∼LogNormal(depth_meanlog,depth_sdlog2)
## sg∼Gamma(nb_size_shape,nb_size_rate) (These control the gene-specific negative-binomial size parameters.)
## Number of marker genes assigned to each topic. These marker genes get larger weights in the topic-gene distribution, so topics become more distinguishable. Larger values usually make topic recovery easier.
one_simulation <- function(seed = 1,
                           N = 500,
                           G = 1000,
                           K = 6,
                           P = 1,
                           B = NULL,
                           n_nonzero_per_condition = 2,
                           effect_size = 1.0,
                           balanced = TRUE,
                           markers_per_topic = 40,
                           sigma_eta = 0.7,
                           depth_meanlog = log(5000),
                           depth_sdlog = 0.5,
                           nb_size_shape = 5,
                           nb_size_rate = 0.5,
                           fit_numiter = 300,
                           eps = 1e-4,
                           alpha = 0.05) {
  set.seed(seed)

  topic_names <- paste0("T", seq_len(K))
  sample_names <- paste0("sample", seq_len(N))

  X <- matrix(rbinom(N * P, size = 1, prob = 0.5), nrow = N, ncol = P)
  colnames(X) <- paste0("x", seq_len(P))
  rownames(X) <- sample_names

  if (is.null(B)) {
    B <- make_sparse_effects(
      K = K,
      P = P,
      n_nonzero_per_condition = n_nonzero_per_condition,
      effect_size = effect_size,
      balanced = balanced
    )
  }
  colnames(B) <- topic_names

  topic_gene <- make_topic_gene_matrix(
    K = K,
    G = G,
    markers_per_topic = markers_per_topic
  )
  phi_true <- topic_gene$phi
  rownames(phi_true) <- topic_names

  memb <- simulate_topic_proportions(X = X, B = B, sigma_eta = sigma_eta)
  theta_true <- memb$theta
  colnames(theta_true) <- topic_names
  rownames(theta_true) <- sample_names

  depth <- round(rlnorm(N, meanlog = depth_meanlog, sdlog = depth_sdlog))
  size_g <- rgamma(G, shape = nb_size_shape, rate = nb_size_rate)

  Y <- simulate_nb_counts(
    theta = theta_true,
    phi = phi_true,
    depth = depth,
    size_g = size_g
  )
  rownames(Y) <- sample_names

  fit <- fastTopics::fit_poisson_nmf(
    Y,
    k = K,
    numiter = fit_numiter,
    verbose = "none"
  )
  fit_mult <- fastTopics::poisson2multinom(fit)
  theta_hat_raw <- fit_mult$L
  phi_hat_raw <- t(fit_mult$F)

  aligned <- align_topics(
    phi_true = phi_true,
    theta_hat = theta_hat_raw,
    phi_hat = phi_hat_raw
  )
  theta_hat <- aligned$theta
  phi_hat <- aligned$phi

  colnames(theta_hat) <- topic_names
  rownames(theta_hat) <- sample_names
  rownames(phi_hat) <- topic_names

  design <- model.matrix(~ ., data = as.data.frame(X))
  coef_index <- 2

  truth_absolute <- B[1, ] != 0
  names(truth_absolute) <- topic_names

  truth_clr_effect <- as.numeric(B[1, ] - mean(B[1, ]))
  names(truth_clr_effect) <- topic_names
  truth_clr <- abs(truth_clr_effect) > 1e-12
  names(truth_clr) <- topic_names

  truth_relative <- true_pairwise_summaries(B[1, ])

  eps_true <- topic_specific_eps(theta_true, c0 = eps)
  eps_hat <- topic_specific_eps(theta_hat, c0 = eps)

  tt_oracle_logit <- run_limma(
    logit_transform(theta_true, eps = eps_true),
    design = design,
    coef_index = coef_index
  )
  q_oracle_logit <- p.adjust(tt_oracle_logit$P.Value, method = "BH")
  det_oracle_logit <- q_oracle_logit < alpha

  tt_hat_raw <- run_limma(theta_hat, design = design, coef_index = coef_index)
  q_hat_raw <- p.adjust(tt_hat_raw$P.Value, method = "BH")
  det_hat_raw <- q_hat_raw < alpha

  tt_hat_logit <- run_limma(
    logit_transform(theta_hat, eps = eps_hat),
    design = design,
    coef_index = coef_index
  )
  q_hat_logit <- p.adjust(tt_hat_logit$P.Value, method = "BH")
  det_hat_logit <- q_hat_logit < alpha

  tt_hat_clr <- run_limma(
    clr_transform(theta_hat, eps = eps_hat),
    design = design,
    coef_index = coef_index
  )
  q_hat_clr <- p.adjust(tt_hat_clr$P.Value, method = "BH")
  det_hat_clr <- q_hat_clr < alpha

  pw_oracle <- pairwise_topic_summaries(
    theta_true,
    design,
    coef_index = coef_index,
    eps = eps_true,
    alpha = alpha
  )
  pw_hat <- pairwise_topic_summaries(
    theta_hat,
    design,
    coef_index = coef_index,
    eps = eps_hat,
    alpha = alpha
  )

  clr_comparison <- fit_clr_method_comparison(
    theta = theta_hat,
    design = design,
    truth_clr = truth_clr,
    truth_clr_effect = truth_clr_effect,
    coef_index = coef_index,
    eps_c0 = eps,
    alpha = alpha
  )

  clr_truth_df <- data.frame(
    topic = topic_names,
    truth_absolute = as.logical(truth_absolute),
    truth_clr = as.logical(truth_clr),
    truth_clr_effect = as.numeric(truth_clr_effect),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  list(
    X = X,
    B = B,
    phi_true = phi_true,
    theta_true = theta_true,
    depth = depth,
    size_g = size_g,
    Y = Y,
    theta_hat = theta_hat,
    phi_hat = phi_hat,
    matched_similarity = stats::setNames(aligned$matched_similarity, topic_names),
    truth_absolute = truth_absolute,
    truth_clr = truth_clr,
    truth_clr_effect = truth_clr_effect,
    truth_relative = truth_relative,
    topic_results = list(
      oracle_logit = data.frame(
        topic = topic_names,
        tt_oracle_logit,
        qval = q_oracle_logit,
        detected = det_oracle_logit,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ),
      hat_raw = data.frame(
        topic = topic_names,
        tt_hat_raw,
        qval = q_hat_raw,
        detected = det_hat_raw,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ),
      hat_logit = data.frame(
        topic = topic_names,
        tt_hat_logit,
        qval = q_hat_logit,
        detected = det_hat_logit,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ),
      hat_clr = data.frame(
        topic = topic_names,
        tt_hat_clr,
        qval = q_hat_clr,
        detected = det_hat_clr,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    ),
    topic_metrics = rbind(
      oracle_logit = score_calls(det_oracle_logit, truth_absolute),
      hat_raw = score_calls(det_hat_raw, truth_absolute),
      hat_logit = score_calls(det_hat_logit, truth_absolute),
      hat_clr = score_calls(det_hat_clr, truth_clr)
    ),
    clr_theta_hat = clr_comparison$theta_clr,
    clr_eps_hat = clr_comparison$eps_k,
    clr_results = clr_comparison$results,
    clr_results_long = clr_comparison$results_long,
    clr_method_metrics = clr_comparison$metrics,
    clr_truth = clr_truth_df,
    pairwise_summaries = list(
      truth = truth_relative,
      oracle = pw_oracle,
      hat = pw_hat
    )
  )
}

run_simulation_study <- function(nsim = 50, keep_sims = TRUE, ...) {
  sims <- if (isTRUE(keep_sims)) vector("list", nsim) else NULL
  clr_metrics <- vector("list", nsim)
  baseline_metrics <- vector("list", nsim)

  for (s in seq_len(nsim)) {
    cat("Running simulation", s, "of", nsim, "\n")
    sim_obj <- one_simulation(seed = 1000 + s, ...)
    if (isTRUE(keep_sims)) {
      sims[[s]] <- sim_obj
    }

    this_clr <- as.data.frame(sim_obj$clr_method_metrics)
    this_clr$method <- rownames(this_clr)
    this_clr$sim <- s
    rownames(this_clr) <- NULL
    clr_metrics[[s]] <- this_clr

    this_baseline <- as.data.frame(sim_obj$topic_metrics)
    this_baseline$method <- rownames(this_baseline)
    this_baseline$sim <- s
    rownames(this_baseline) <- NULL
    baseline_metrics[[s]] <- this_baseline
  }

  clr_metrics_df <- do.call(rbind, clr_metrics)
  baseline_metrics_df <- do.call(rbind, baseline_metrics)
  rownames(clr_metrics_df) <- NULL
  rownames(baseline_metrics_df) <- NULL

  list(
    per_simulation = clr_metrics_df,
    summary = summarize_method_metrics(clr_metrics_df),
    baseline_per_simulation = baseline_metrics_df,
    baseline_summary = summarize_method_metrics(baseline_metrics_df),
    sims = sims
  )
}

stack_performance_metrics <- function(per_simulation_df) {
  rbind(
    data.frame(
      per_simulation_df,
      metric = "Power",
      value = per_simulation_df$power,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ),
    data.frame(
      per_simulation_df,
      metric = "FDR",
      value = per_simulation_df$FDP,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
setup_julia_epb <- local({
  initialized <- FALSE

  function(
    JULIA_HOME = "/opt/anaconda3/julia_env/pyjuliapkg/install/bin",
    project_path = "/opt/anaconda3/julia_env"
  ) {
    if (!initialized) {
      library(JuliaCall)

      julia_setup(JULIA_HOME = JULIA_HOME)
      julia_command("import Pkg")
      julia_command(sprintf('Pkg.activate("%s")', project_path))
      julia_command("using Empirikos, Hypatia, MultipleTesting")

      initialized <<- TRUE
    }

    invisible(TRUE)
  }
})

run_epb_one_coef_from_fit <- function(fit, coef_index = 2, alpha = 0.05) {
  coef_hat <- fit$coefficients
  se_hat   <- sweep(fit$stdev.unscaled, 1, fit$sigma, "*")

  beta_vec <- as.numeric(coef_hat[, coef_index])
  se2_vec  <- as.numeric(se_hat[, coef_index]^2)

  df_resid <- fit$df.residual
  nu_val <- unique(as.integer(df_resid[is.finite(df_resid)]))

  if (length(nu_val) != 1L) {
    warning("Residual degrees of freedom are not identical across topics; using the first value.")
    nu_val <- nu_val[1]
  }

  ok <- is.finite(beta_vec) & is.finite(se2_vec) & (se2_vec > 0)

  adjp <- rep(NA_real_, length(beta_vec))
  rj_idx <- rep(FALSE, length(beta_vec))

  if (any(ok)) {
    julia_assign("beta_vec_r", beta_vec[ok])
    julia_assign("se2_vec_r", se2_vec[ok])
    julia_assign("nu_val_r", as.integer(nu_val))
    julia_assign("alpha_r", alpha)

    julia_command("
      samples_epb = [
        Empirikos.NormalChiSquareSample(beta_vec_r[i], se2_vec_r[i], nu_val_r)
        for i in eachindex(beta_vec_r)
      ]
    ")
    julia_command("
      test_epb_r = Empirikos.EmpiricalPartiallyBayesTTest(
        α = alpha_r,
        solver = Hypatia.Optimizer
      )
    ")
    julia_command("res_epb_r = fit(test_epb_r, samples_epb)")

    adjp_ok <- as.numeric(julia_eval("res_epb_r.adjp"))
    rj_ok   <- as.logical(julia_eval("res_epb_r.rj_idx"))

    adjp[ok]   <- adjp_ok
    rj_idx[ok] <- rj_ok
  }

  list(
    adjp = adjp,
    rj_idx = rj_idx,
    beta = beta_vec,
    se = sqrt(se2_vec),
    df = rep(as.numeric(nu_val), length(beta_vec))
  )
}

extract_epb_np_results <- function(
  fit,
  coef_index = 2,
  alpha = 0.05,
  julia_home = "/opt/anaconda3/julia_env/pyjuliapkg/install/bin",
  project_path = "/opt/anaconda3/julia_env"
) {
  topics <- resolve_fit_topics(fit)

  if (!requireNamespace("JuliaCall", quietly = TRUE)) {
    return(data.frame(
      topic = topics,
      method = "epb_np",
      effect = NA_real_,
      SE = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      q_value = NA_real_,
      lfsr = NA_real_,
      detected = NA,
      available = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }

  setup_julia_epb(
    JULIA_HOME = julia_home,
    project_path = project_path
  )

  epb_out <- run_epb_one_coef_from_fit(
    fit = fit,
    coef_index = coef_index,
    alpha = alpha
  )

  data.frame(
    topic = topics,
    method = "epb_np",
    effect = epb_out$beta,
    SE = epb_out$se,
    df = epb_out$df,
    p_value = epb_out$adjp,   # EPB returns adjusted p-values directly
    q_value = epb_out$adjp,
    lfsr = NA_real_,
    detected = epb_out$rj_idx,
    available = TRUE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}



fit_clr_method_comparison <- function(theta,
                                      design,
                                      truth_clr,
                                      truth_clr_effect,
                                      coef_index = 2,
                                      eps_c0 = 1e-4,
                                      alpha = 0.05) {
  eps_k <- topic_specific_eps(theta, c0 = eps_c0)
  theta_clr <- clr_transform(theta, eps = eps_k)

  fit_lm <- limma::lmFit(t(theta_clr), design)
  fit_eb <- limma::eBayes(fit_lm)


  
  method_results <- list(
    no_eb = extract_nomod_results(fit_lm, coef_index = coef_index, alpha = alpha),
    limma = extract_limma_results(fit_eb, coef_index = coef_index, alpha = alpha),
    vashr = extract_vash_results(fit_lm, coef_index = coef_index, alpha = alpha),
    epb_np = extract_epb_np_results(fit_lm, coef_index = coef_index, alpha = alpha),
    mr.ashr = extract_mr_ash_results(theta_clr, design, coef_index = coef_index, alpha = alpha)
  )
  results_long <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(method_results, function(df) {
      df$truth <- truth_clr[match(df$topic, names(truth_clr))]
      df$truth_effect <- truth_clr_effect[match(df$topic, names(truth_clr_effect))]
      df
    })
  )
  rownames(results_long) <- NULL

  metrics <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(method_results, function(df) {
      df$truth <- truth_clr[match(df$topic, names(truth_clr))]
      score_calls(df$detected, df$truth)
    })
  )

  list(
    theta_clr = theta_clr,
    eps_k = eps_k,
    results = method_results,
    results_long = results_long,
    metrics = metrics
  )
}
```

```{r}
summarize_benchmark_performance <- function(per_simulation_df) {
  perf_long <- stack_performance_metrics(per_simulation_df)

  grouping_keys <- unique(
    perf_long[, c(
      "varying_param", "varying_value", "method", "metric",
      "N", "G", "K", "markers_per_topic", "n_nonzero_per_condition",
      "effect_size", "sigma_eta",
      "depth_meanlog", "depth_sdlog",
      "nb_size_shape", "nb_size_rate",
      "fit_numiter", "alpha"
    )]
  )

  rows <- vector("list", nrow(grouping_keys))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(grouping_keys))) {
    key <- grouping_keys[i, , drop = FALSE]
    keep <- perf_long$varying_param == key$varying_param &
      perf_long$varying_value == key$varying_value &
      perf_long$method == key$method &
      perf_long$metric == key$metric

    x <- perf_long$value[keep]
    x <- as.numeric(x[is.finite(x)])
    n <- length(x)
    mean_x <- if (n) mean(x) else NA_real_
    sd_x <- if (n > 1L) stats::sd(x) else 0
    se_x <- if (n) sd_x / sqrt(n) else NA_real_

    rows[[i]] <- cbind(
      key,
      n = n,
      mean = mean_x,
      sd = sd_x,
      ci95_lo = if (n) mean_x - 1.96 * se_x else NA_real_,
      ci95_hi = if (n) mean_x + 1.96 * se_x else NA_real_
    )
  }

  out <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  rownames(out) <- NULL
  out
}


plot_benchmark_curve <- function(summary_df, varying_param) {
  if (!requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("The 'ggplot2' package is required for plotting.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  summary_sub <- summary_df[summary_df$varying_param == varying_param, , drop = FALSE]
  if (!nrow(summary_sub)) {
    stop(sprintf("No rows found for varying_param = '%s'.", varying_param), call. = FALSE)
  }

  # summary_sub$method <- factor(
  #   summary_sub$method,
  #   levels = c("no_eb", "limma", "vashr", "mr.ashr")
  # )
  summary_sub$method <- factor(
    summary_sub$method,
    levels = c("no_eb", "limma", "vashr", "epb_np", "mr.ashr")
  )

  summary_sub$x_plot <- factor(summary_sub$varying_value, levels = sort(unique(summary_sub$varying_value)))

  label_map <- c(
    G = "Number of genes (G)",
    K = "Number of topics (K)",
    markers_per_topic = "Marker genes per topic",
    n_nonzero_per_condition = "Nonzero topics per condition",
    N = "Sample size (N)",
    effect_size = "Effect size",
    sigma_eta = "sigma_eta"
  )

  xlab <- if (varying_param %in% names(label_map)) label_map[[varying_param]] else varying_param

  pd <- ggplot2::position_dodge(width = 0.5)

  ggplot2::ggplot(
    summary_sub,
    ggplot2::aes(x = x_plot, y = mean, color = method, group = method)
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(
      data = summary_sub[summary_sub$metric == "FDR", , drop = FALSE],
      ggplot2::aes(yintercept = 0.05),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey50"
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(ggplot2::aes(linetype = method)) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      ggplot2::aes(shape = method),
      size = 2.5,
      position = pd
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_errorbar(
      ggplot2::aes(ymin = ci95_lo, ymax = ci95_hi),
      width = 0.15,
      linewidth = 0.5,
      position = pd
    ) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y") +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x = xlab,
      y = "Across-replicate estimate",
      color = "Method",
      shape = "Method",
      linetype = "Method",
      title = paste("CLR performance as a function of", xlab)
    )
}

validate_benchmark_grid <- function(settings_df) {
  bad <- settings_df$G < (settings_df$K * settings_df$markers_per_topic)
  if (any(bad)) {
    bad_rows <- settings_df[bad, , drop = FALSE]
    stop(
      sprintf(
        "Invalid benchmark settings: need G >= K * markers_per_topic. Bad rows: %s",
        paste(
          apply(
            bad_rows,
            1,
            function(z) paste(names(bad_rows), z, sep = "=", collapse = ", ")
          ),
          collapse = " | "
        )
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  invisible(settings_df)
}

make_benchmark_settings <- function(
    N = 250,
    G = 1000,
    K = 6,
    markers_per_topic = 40,
    n_nonzero_per_condition = 2,
    effect_size = 1.0,
    sigma_eta = 0.7,
    depth_meanlog = log(5000),
    depth_sdlog = 0.5,
    nb_size_shape = 5,
    nb_size_rate = 0.5,
    fit_numiter = 120,
    alpha = 0.05,
    sweep_values = list(
      N = c(80, 150, 250),
      G = c(300, 600, 1000, 1600),
      K = c(4, 6, 8, 10),
      markers_per_topic = c(10, 20, 40, 60),
      n_nonzero_per_condition = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
      effect_size = c(0.2, 0.4, 0.7, 1.0),
      sigma_eta = c(0.5, 0.7, 1.0, 1.3)
    )) {

  baseline <- list(
    N = N,
    G = G,
    K = K,
    markers_per_topic = markers_per_topic,
    n_nonzero_per_condition = n_nonzero_per_condition,
    effect_size = effect_size,
    sigma_eta = sigma_eta,
    depth_meanlog = depth_meanlog,
    depth_sdlog = depth_sdlog,
    nb_size_shape = nb_size_shape,
    nb_size_rate = nb_size_rate,
    fit_numiter = fit_numiter,
    alpha = alpha
  )

  settings <- list()
  idx <- 1L

  for (nm in names(sweep_values)) {
    vals <- sweep_values[[nm]]
    for (val in vals) {
      cur <- baseline
      cur[[nm]] <- val

      settings[[idx]] <- data.frame(
        setting_id = idx,
        varying_param = nm,
        varying_value = as.numeric(val),
        N = cur$N,
        G = cur$G,
        K = cur$K,
        markers_per_topic = cur$markers_per_topic,
        n_nonzero_per_condition = cur$n_nonzero_per_condition,
        effect_size = cur$effect_size,
        sigma_eta = cur$sigma_eta,
        depth_meanlog = cur$depth_meanlog,
        depth_sdlog = cur$depth_sdlog,
        nb_size_shape = cur$nb_size_shape,
        nb_size_rate = cur$nb_size_rate,
        fit_numiter = cur$fit_numiter,
        alpha = cur$alpha,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      idx <- idx + 1L
    }
  }

  settings_df <- do.call(rbind, settings)
  rownames(settings_df) <- NULL
  validate_benchmark_grid(settings_df)
  settings_df
}


run_difficulty_benchmark <- function(
    nsim = 10,
    N = 250,
    G = 1000,
    K = 6,
    markers_per_topic = 40,
    n_nonzero_per_condition = 2,
    effect_size = 1.0,
    sigma_eta = 0.7,
    depth_meanlog = log(5000),
    depth_sdlog = 0.5,
    nb_size_shape = 5,
    nb_size_rate = 0.5,
    fit_numiter = 120,
    alpha = 0.05,
    sweep_values = list(
      N = c(80, 150, 250),
      G = c(300, 600, 1000, 1600),
      K = c(4, 6, 8, 10),
      markers_per_topic = c(10, 20, 40, 60),
      n_nonzero_per_condition = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
      effect_size = c(0.2, 0.4, 0.7, 1.0),
      sigma_eta = c(0.5, 0.7, 1.0, 1.3)
    ),
    save_sims = FALSE) {

  settings_df <- make_benchmark_settings(
    N = N,
    G = G,
    K = K,
    markers_per_topic = markers_per_topic,
    n_nonzero_per_condition = n_nonzero_per_condition,
    effect_size = effect_size,
    sigma_eta = sigma_eta,
    depth_meanlog = depth_meanlog,
    depth_sdlog = depth_sdlog,
    nb_size_shape = nb_size_shape,
    nb_size_rate = nb_size_rate,
    fit_numiter = fit_numiter,
    alpha = alpha,
    sweep_values = sweep_values
  )

  per_setting <- vector("list", nrow(settings_df))
  summary_rows <- vector("list", nrow(settings_df))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(settings_df))) {
    setting <- settings_df[i, , drop = FALSE]
    cat(
      "Benchmark setting", i, "of", nrow(settings_df), ":",
      setting$varying_param, "=", setting$varying_value, "\n"
    )

    study <- run_simulation_study(
      nsim = nsim,
      keep_sims = save_sims,
      N = setting$N,
      G = setting$G,
      K = setting$K,
      P = 1,
      markers_per_topic = setting$markers_per_topic,
      n_nonzero_per_condition = setting$n_nonzero_per_condition,
      effect_size = setting$effect_size,
      sigma_eta = setting$sigma_eta,
      depth_meanlog = setting$depth_meanlog,
      depth_sdlog = setting$depth_sdlog,
      nb_size_shape = setting$nb_size_shape,
      nb_size_rate = setting$nb_size_rate,
      fit_numiter = setting$fit_numiter,
      alpha = setting$alpha
    )

    per_sim <- study$per_simulation
    per_sim$setting_id <- setting$setting_id
    per_sim$varying_param <- setting$varying_param
    per_sim$varying_value <- setting$varying_value
    per_sim$N <- setting$N
    per_sim$G <- setting$G
    per_sim$K <- setting$K
    per_sim$markers_per_topic <- setting$markers_per_topic
    per_sim$n_nonzero_per_condition <- setting$n_nonzero_per_condition
    per_sim$effect_size <- setting$effect_size
    per_sim$sigma_eta <- setting$sigma_eta
    per_sim$depth_meanlog <- setting$depth_meanlog
    per_sim$depth_sdlog <- setting$depth_sdlog
    per_sim$nb_size_shape <- setting$nb_size_shape
    per_sim$nb_size_rate <- setting$nb_size_rate
    per_sim$fit_numiter <- setting$fit_numiter
    per_sim$alpha <- setting$alpha

    per_setting[[i]] <- per_sim

    setting_summary <- study$summary
    setting_summary$setting_id <- setting$setting_id
    setting_summary$varying_param <- setting$varying_param
    setting_summary$varying_value <- setting$varying_value
    setting_summary$N <- setting$N
    setting_summary$G <- setting$G
    setting_summary$K <- setting$K
    setting_summary$markers_per_topic <- setting$markers_per_topic
    setting_summary$n_nonzero_per_condition <- setting$n_nonzero_per_condition
    setting_summary$effect_size <- setting$effect_size
    setting_summary$sigma_eta <- setting$sigma_eta
    setting_summary$depth_meanlog <- setting$depth_meanlog
    setting_summary$depth_sdlog <- setting$depth_sdlog
    setting_summary$nb_size_shape <- setting$nb_size_shape
    setting_summary$nb_size_rate <- setting$nb_size_rate
    setting_summary$fit_numiter <- setting$fit_numiter
    setting_summary$alpha <- setting$alpha

    summary_rows[[i]] <- setting_summary
  }

  per_simulation_df <- do.call(rbind, per_setting)
  per_setting_summary_df <- do.call(rbind, summary_rows)
  curve_summary_df <- summarize_benchmark_performance(per_simulation_df)

  rownames(per_simulation_df) <- NULL
  rownames(per_setting_summary_df) <- NULL
  rownames(curve_summary_df) <- NULL

  list(
    settings = settings_df,
    per_simulation = per_simulation_df,
    per_setting_summary = per_setting_summary_df,
    curve_summary = curve_summary_df
  )
}
```
